title: Project Roadmap Schema
description: Validates docs/roadmap.json — the machine-readable project delivery plan.

_comment.description: Optional human-readable note about the file (JSON has no native comments).

current_phase.description: ID of the currently active phase. Must match one of phases[*].id.

current_outcome.description: The highest-priority must-achieve outcome for the current phase (plain English).

id.description: Stable machine-readable identifier for this phase (e.g. 'phase_1').

description.description: Optional longer description of what this phase covers.

exit_criteria.description: List of measurable criteria that must be met to exit this phase.

tickets_advancing_outcome.description: List of ticket identifiers (paths or slugs) that directly advance the current_outcome for this phase.
